subject: PoC deployment options - Acme Corp
message_1_body:
Thanks Marissa — great call today. Quick recap from our side and a few clarifying questions:

Summary:
- Goal: Evaluate Redwood for an LLM-powered support summarization feature across US customers.
- Initial priorities: data residency (US), security/compliance (BAA + audit logs), and predictable latency for our chat use (p95 < 200ms).

From the call we heard three deployment options: Hosted API, Dedicated capacity, and Private (VPC/on-prem). Our internal priorities push us towards either Dedicated or Private because of isolation and contractual controls.

Success criteria we want validated in the PoC:
1) Latency: p95 < 200ms for generation (context sizes up to ~1k tokens).
2) Throughput: sustain 150-200 requests/sec during peak tests.
3) Security: BAA in place, audit logs available, and optional VPC peering or on-prem install if required.
4) Quality: model outputs meet our NLU test suite (we'll share prompt set).

Timeline: Ideally a 3-4 week PoC: week 0 = kick-off + data prep, week 1 = hosted functional validation, week 2 = perf/scale on Dedicated or Private, week 3 = wrap-up and handoff.

Questions / asks for Redwood:
- Can you share a PoC plan with milestones and owners?
- Rough sizing/quote for a Dedicated trial (GPU type, expected cost for 4 weeks).
- Clarify what the Private VPC/on-prem package includes and lead time for setup.

Thanks — looping in Priya (legal/procurement) for procurement constraints.

Ellis
Director, Product
Acme Corp
message_2_body:
Thanks Ellis — really helpful summary.

Attached is a first-draft PoC proposal (redwood-poc-proposal.pdf) and a short security checklist template (acme-security-reqs.xlsx) that maps to our Private/Dedicated features. Key items below and proposed owners: 

Proposed PoC approach (two-track, compressed into 3-4 weeks):
- Week 0 (kickoff, 2-3 days): finalize success criteria, share prompt/test corpus, confirm data flows and access. Owners: Marissa (RPO), Priya/Acme procurement.
- Week 1 (functional validation on Hosted API, 1 week): validate model quality, integration, basic latency checks. Owners: Acme engs + Rishi (solutions).
- Week 2 (performance + security on Dedicated trial or Private VPC, 1 week): run sustained throughput tests, network/security validation, verify audit logs & encryption. Owners: Vivek (capacity), Acme infra.
- Week 3 (analysis + wrap): review results, legal sign-off, next-step recommendation.

Success criteria (aligns with what you listed):
- p95 latency < 200ms for 1k-token context in perf profile tests
- Sustained 150-200 rps for 5-minute soak tests
- Audit logs available and BAA scoping confirmed
- Pass on the NLU prompt suite (we'll run A/B vs your baseline)

Rough Dedicated trial sizing / cost (ballpark):
- 4-week trial using 4x NVIDIA A10G equivalent nodes, continuous burst-friendly config - estimated commit $28k- $35k (final quote after exact traffic profile). Vivek will follow up with a detailed sizing + quote by EOD tomorrow.

Private VPC/on-prem notes:
- VPC option: customer-managed peering with private control plane + KMS integration; typical lead time 2-3 weeks for provisioning and network setup.
- On-prem: packaged deployment with support, lead time typically 4-6 weeks and a separate licensing engagement.

Next steps:
1) Vivek: detailed Dedicated sizing & quote (by 2026-02-26 COB).
2) Rishi: schedule a security deep-dive (30-45m) with Acme security team - propose Wed/Thu this week.
3) Acme: share prompt/test set and any redlines to the attached security checklist.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call to walk through the draft.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
message_3_body:
Thanks Marissa — quick clarifications from procurement/legal: 

- Acme prefers Private VPC for regulated PII workloads; can you confirm whether the VPC option supports customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS) and if audit logs can be exported to our Splunk instance?
- Procurement timeline: we need an initial cost estimate and a procurement-friendly invoice/quote for a 4-week trial to get internal approvals.

Also: is there a lean on-prem evaluation (containerized) we could run in our lab instead of full on-prem install, just to validate network/firewall constraints?

Thanks — Priya
Sr. Manager, Procurement
message_4_body:
Hi Priya — short answers and proposed path forward.

1) VPC & KMS: Yes - the Private VPC option supports customer-managed AWS KMS and we can configure audit log export to your Splunk/S3 ingestion. We'll include the specific architecture diagram in the next doc.

2) Lean on-prem: we offer a "lab" evaluation package (containerized runtime + limited data plane) that can be stood up in your internal lab in ~1 week. It's designed to validate networking/firewall, latency, and E2E integration without a full production install. Good option if you want to accelerate technical sign-off.

3) Quote / procurement: Vivek will deliver a procurement-ready quote for the 4-week Dedicated trial (and a separate configurator for the Private lab) by EOD today. That quote will include line items for trial capacity, optional support, and any setup fees.

Proposed next steps (concrete owners & dates):
- 2026-02-26: Vivek to send Dedicated trial quote + Private lab config (Vivek).
- 2026-02-27: Security deep-dive with Rishi + Acme security (Rishi to propose times).
- 2026-03-02: Kickoff call + data sharing (Marissa / Acme eng).

If that works I'll book the security session and share invites.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
